position_truncation.rule: max_length + pad_id + 1; RoBERTa position ids = pad_id + cumsum(non-pad mask), pads use pad_id

position_indexing.rule: non-pad tokens: padding_idx + cumsum(non_pad_mask); pad slots: padding_idx

3tr4.note: vay tiêu dùng trả kỳ này 3tr4

1.5tr.note: Ngân vay tao 1.5tr, mai mốt gửi lại

targets.heuristic: person = the word before the target (or the target's first word) is a title/kinship word ['anh', 'chị', 'chi', 'em', 'cô', 'co', 'chú', 'chu', 'bác', 'bac', 'dì', 'di', 'ông', 'ong', 'bà', 'ba', 'bạn', 'ban', 'mợ', 'mo', 'cậu', 'cau', 'dượng', 'duong'], OR every target word is capitalized (not ALL-CAPS), <=4 words, no digits, and the note type is not expense/refund; everything else = merchant_brand_other. Types are used only to label analysis rows.

chosen_policy.name: B-rank-8000
chosen_policy.embedding_copy: all 8,338 kept rows copied exactly from the trained/pretrained rows (old id order preserved); specials keep ids 0-3, <mask> last

trained.fit: all 3 seeds: in-sample validation type F1 1.000, span F1 1.000 at epoch 40

size_latency.note: seed 1 of each; latency is CPU batch-1, 1 thread, this Mac; ~0.1 ms run-to-run noise

depth_estimates_int8_mb.method: measured 4x768 pos32+B-rank-8000 INT8 minus ~1 byte per removed layer parameter
